title: Handmade Resin Wall Clock – Amber Marble
description:
Product Specifications

Material: Epoxy resin, clock mechanism, Roman numeral markers, decorative gold crystal accents
Colour Palette: Amber, ivory, white, gold, and black
Style: Modern luxury, handmade home decor, statement wall art
Finish: Glossy resin finish
Clock Type: Functional wall clock
Design: One-of-a-kind resin marble pattern

Best For: Living room, bedroom, hallway, entryway, office, housewarming gifts, wedding gifts

Customisation: Colours, size, and detailing can be customised on request

Care: Wipe gently with a soft dry cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals and prolonged direct sunlight.

Availability: Handmade to order
